verdict: Still a private company weeks before its IPO filing, Reddit posted a rare profit in Q4 2023 — $19M of net income on $250M of revenue — as advertising grew and running costs barely moved.

kpis.label: Net income
kpis.note: vs a $22.2M loss a year ago

kpis.label: Daily users (DAUq)
kpis.note: average daily active uniques in the quarter

segments.name: Advertising
segments.note: Ads shown across Reddit's communities — 99% of all revenue this quarter.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Mostly Reddit Premium subscriptions and other small streams — the data-licensing business only took off in 2024.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Engineers building the product and the ad platform — the biggest cost line, including stock-based pay.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling ads to brands and marketing Reddit itself.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal and admin, including stock-based pay.

takeaways.title: Ads carried the quarter
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 25% year-over-year to $250M, and $247M of it was advertising. Gross margin was 88% — Reddit's content is written by its users, so serving it is cheap.

takeaways.title: A rare profit
takeaways.text: Net income of $18.5M was Reddit's first profitable quarter since Q4 2021. The operating profit was a slim $3M — $16.5M of interest and other income did most of the work.

takeaways.title: The audience kept growing
takeaways.text: Daily active uniques averaged 73.1M in the quarter. Weeks later, on February 22, 2024, Reddit filed its IPO prospectus — the document these figures come from — and listed on the NYSE that March.

otherDetail: Other income of $16.5M, net — $15.3M of interest income, net, earned on Reddit's cash and marketable securities, plus $1.1M of other income. It is what turned a $3.0M operating profit into a $19.5M pre-tax profit.
footerNote: Reddit was a private company in Q4 2023, so there was no earnings release. Figures are from the unaudited quarterly results table in Reddit's IPO prospectus (Form S-1, filed February 22, 2024), which reports in thousands; the advertising/other revenue split is full-year 2023 (FY2024 Form 10-K) less the nine months to September 2023 (Q3 2024 Form 10-Q). The 'Reported' date above is the S-1 filing date — the first public disclosure of these results.
